ma.createVideoContext(string id)

Create the VideoContext object.

Parameter

string id

ID of the video component.

Return Value

VideoContext

A VideoContext object.

Sample Code


<video
  id='myVideo'
  src='https://example.test.com/video'
/>

Page ({
  onLoad () {
    this.videoContext = ma.createVideoContext ('myVideo');
  },
});
